prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: high-resolution glyph sprite sheet for a personal Vagrant Story dialogue font restoration. Edit target: the attached 1280x1024 sheet of EXACTLY 20 original game glyphs in a fixed FIVE column by FOUR row grid. Reconstruct the existing letter silhouettes with crisp smoothly curved antialiased high-resolution contours, eliminating the large pixel staircase. This is restoration of these particular hand-drawn italic glyphs, NOT replacement with a different typeface. Keep each character inside its original grid cell; keep its exact overall width, height, baseline, stroke weight, slant, asymmetry, distinctive serifs/terminals, and relative position. Do not normalize them to a generic font. Glyph order row 1: 0 1 2 3 4. Row 2: 5 6 7 8 9. Row 3: A E G H I. Row 4: N O R S T. The 9 must retain its original rounded/angled bowl and leftward descending tail, not a modern straight-tail 9. The T must retain its very broad long flat top bar and diagonally left-leaning stem toward the baseline. The 1 and I have their own distinct source serifs. Trace the center of the gray edge transition to infer the intended smooth contours rather than preserving square blocks. Preserve counters/open gaps. Render solid black glyph ink with subtle edge antialiasing on a genuinely transparent background. Keep the same 5x4 layout, same canvas aspect ratio, same generous whitespace per cell; no added characters, labels, borders, grid lines, shadows, outlines, decoration, texture, or watermark. Do not concatenate into words. No creative redesign.
